title: Statblock Entry Schema
description: An action, bonus action or reaction inside a Statblock node. Activity-like: entries with a `mechanic` are rendered by the mechanic formatter; entries without one fall back to `description`. Traits are prose-only and are not covered by this schema.

id.description: Required. Enables [id=...] selectors in Effect targets.

description.description: Prose fallback for entries not yet ported to `mechanic`.
